_comment: Copy to stories/the-lighthouse-cat/briefs.json. Descriptions are prompt text in English. Reference photos: cast/<name>/source.jpg (or built mug shots cast/<name>/front.png ...), locations/<loc>/*.jpg as listed below, objects/<obj>.png.

defaults.register: Quiet, naturalistic scene on a windy northern coast, soft overcast light, no exaggerated styling unless a style pack is given.

characters.pip: a small grey tabby cat with a white chest and white front paws, a torn left ear, bright amber eyes and a thin red collar with a brass bell

mugshot_direction.pip: For the smiling shot: eyes half-closed in contentment, whiskers forward.

lighthouse.description: A white stone lighthouse with a red iron lantern room on a rocky headland, a narrow spiral staircase inside with whitewashed walls and small deep-set windows, grey sea all around.
